summary: Sprint 11 — AI Morning Brief verified end-to-end. Backend GET /api/dashboard/morning-brief returns the full documented payload (greeting, summary, wins, risks, recommendations with revenue_impact, numbers{6 keys}, what_ai_did) and stays consistent with /api/dashboard/executive (pipeline/revenue/hours_saved/business_health equal). Org isolation verified across two demo tenants. No regressions on executive/summary/opportunities/crm/automation/memory endpoints. Frontend: after clicking explore-demo-btn the Morning Brief modal auto-opens on first dashboard visit; the second same-day visit correctly does NOT auto-reopen (localStorage guard works). Hero greeting + 'Here's what happened while you were away' present. brief-numbers grid renders (6 tiles). All 5 collapsibles (brief-summary/-wins/-risks/-recommendations/-ai-activity) render and their -toggle buttons open/close smoothly. Summary/win/risk/rec items render (4/1/1/3 on seeded demo). brief-risk-action navigates (/clients) and closes modal. open-morning-brief reopens modal; hero-ask-ai present; brief-dismiss closes. Dashboard V2 KPIs/chart/exec brief still render — no regression.

issues: Radix a11y warning: DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for screen readers. Add a VisuallyHidden <DialogTitle> in MorningBrief.jsx to silence and improve a11y.

action_items: Minor: add a VisuallyHidden DialogTitle inside the MorningBrief Dialog for a11y (Radix warning in console).
critical_code_review_comments: MorningBrief.jsx: missing DialogTitle inside DialogContent — Radix a11y warning appears in console; wrap a hidden title (VisuallyHidden) to fix.
Pre-existing benign 401s during dashboard mount (likely notifications/billing polling) — unrelated to Morning Brief.
dashboard_exec.py morning_brief overdue detector compares ISO date strings — ok in practice but fragile; consider parsing dates.
Consider adding a DialogTitle/aria-label for a11y across all shadcn modals project-wide.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint 11 Morning Brief testids: morning-brief (Dialog), brief-numbers, brief-summary/-wins/-risks/-recommendations/-ai-activity each with -toggle, brief-summary-item, brief-win-item, brief-risk-item, brief-risk-action, brief-rec-item, brief-rec-action, brief-ai-item, brief-dismiss, plus open-morning-brief and hero-ask-ai on Dashboard hero. Auto-open localStorage key: mb_seen_{userId}_{YYYY-MM-DD}. Backend endpoint: GET /api/dashboard/morning-brief; reuses executive() for numbers/insights/ai_activity.
